'''Lurkers''' were a group of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] bipedal [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] creatures, found throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. 

They were carrion eaters that preferred to live in tropical environments. They never got too near to settlements or to anything that could be a threat for a single specimen, in fact, they usually traveled and hunted in packs, striking with amazing ferocity, downing their preys for later consumption.<ref name="codex" />

Lurkers had three digits on their arms and four on their legs. Their red eyes were located on the opposite sides of the head with multiple appendages and sharp little teeth. They had a dorsal sail ending with a short tail.<ref name="rift lurker" /><ref name="zakuul lurker" /> Some of lurkers were venomous.<ref name="venomous lurker">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Venomous Lurker|[[Belsavis]]}}</ref>

==Distribution==
It was believed by [[Biologist/Legends|biologists]] serving the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], that lurkers originated on an [[Unidentified jungle world (Torch Nebula)|unnamed jungle world]] on the edges of the [[Torch Nebula/Legends|Torch Nebula]]. They were first spotted two hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and were later found on multiple other worlds. These creatures' wide distribution left a great mystery, since no convincing explanation was given for their wide spread.<ref name="codex" />

Most commonly found sub-species of lurkers were the [[Rift lurker]], found in great numbers on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]],<ref name="belsavis" /> [[Quesh]],<ref name="quesh">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Quesh]]}}</ref>  [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]<ref name="rishi">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=location|[[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]}}</ref> and the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth moon]] of [[Yavin/Legends|Yavin]]<ref name="yavin">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=location|[[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]}}</ref>, and the [[Zakuul lurker]], found in the [[Endless Swamp]] on [[Zakuul]].<ref name="zakuul lurker" />
